1. Introduction

Welcome to Astro Pulse ("we", "us", "our"). These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of our website, mobile applications, and astrology consultation services (collectively, the "Platform").

By creating an account, topping up your wallet, booking a consultation, or otherwise using the Platform, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years of age and capable of entering into a binding contract under applicable Indian law to use paid consultation services.

You are responsible for ensuring that the information you provide (name, date of birth, place of birth, contact details) is accurate and that you have the right to share any third-party birth details used for kundli or matchmaking features.

3. Nature of services

Astro Pulse connects users with independent astrologers and related services such as chat, voice calls, kundli generation, matchmaking, remedies, and puja bookings.

Astrology, tarot, numerology, and similar offerings are provided for guidance and entertainment. They are not a substitute for professional medical, legal, financial, or psychological advice. You should not make major life decisions based solely on consultations on the Platform.

4. Accounts and wallet

You may need to register with a valid mobile number or email. You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and for all activity under your account.

Wallet top-ups and per-minute or per-session charges are displayed before you start a consultation. Rates may vary by astrologer and service type. Unused wallet balance remains in your account subject to our Refund & Cancellation Policy.

5. Consultations and conduct

You agree to use consultations respectfully. Harassment, hate speech, illegal requests, or sharing of offensive content may result in suspension or termination without refund of amounts already consumed.

Astrologers are independent service providers. While we verify profiles and monitor quality, we do not guarantee specific outcomes, predictions, or timelines.

Recording, redistributing, or commercially exploiting consultation content without consent is prohibited.

Payments are processed through authorised third-party payment gateways. You agree to provide valid payment information and authorise charges for services you initiate.

We may suspend or terminate access if you breach these Terms, engage in fraud, or if required by law or payment partners.

You may stop using the Platform at any time. Provisions that by nature should survive (payments owed, disclaimers, dispute resolution) will remain in effect.
